February 2, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-2-1971-55331

Mia Momtaz Doultana, president of Council Muslim League, in Lahore assures Zulfikar Ali Bhutto, chairman of Pakistan People’s Pary, of full support from him and his party to constitute a useful federal governance policy.

Amanullah, chief of Punjab Farmers’ Association and member of Gujrat National Assembly, Khan Saheb (elected from Lyallpur-now known as Faisalabad), member of National Assembly meet Awami League Chief Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman at his residence. They discuss various problems and future governance policy of the country.

Although the proposed Capital Banking for East Pakistan is principally set, the inauguration of the bank is delayed until formation of parliamentary government. The bank will start operation with Tk 3 crore as capital and government will buy share worth of Tk 1.5 crore of it.

Pakistan handovers 25 passengers and 4 crews of an aircraft allegedly hijacked by two youths of Kashmir United Front. A spokesman of Pakistan foreign ministry says the incident is the expression of people’s frustration against the oppression and repression policy in the occupied Kashmir.

Maulana Abdul Hamid Khan Bhasani, at an interview with Ena in Chittagong, says Bhutto and Sheikh Mujib will be successful in running the administration for a long time if they respect their promise of establishing socialism.
